data.name: Crownmarked
data.detailed_description:
Build your kingdom. Raise your heroes. Break the cycle.

Crownmarked is a kingdom building action RPG set in Vinterra, a fractured fantasy world trapped within an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

You awaken among the ruins of a fallen kingdom with a mysterious connection to a forgotten past. Guided by Morrino, a world-weary penguin adviser who knows more than he initially reveals, you must rebuild what was lost and prepare your people for the dangers beyond your borders.

Rebuild a fallen kingdom

Transform the abandoned foundations into a growing community. Construct homes, workshops, defences and important public buildings, each expanding what your kingdom and its citizens can achieve.

Gather resources, unlock new opportunities and watch the settlement develop from a handful of survivors into a kingdom capable of standing against Vinterra’s greatest threats.

Raise citizens into adventurers

Your citizens are more than just your subjects. Recruit promising individuals, equip them with the best gear and develop them into adventurers who can be sent beyond the safety of your kingdom.

Dispatch adventuring parties to explore dangerous locations, recover valuable resources and uncover more information about the cycle threatening Vinterra. Their victories strengthen the kingdom, while their failures may force you to reconsider how they are trained and prepared.

Fight for Vinterra

However, you are not a distant ruler. Venture into the world and face its dangers through fast-paced third-person melee and magical combat.

Explore forgotten locations, confront corrupted creatures and challenge powerful enemies hidden throughout the world. Combine weapons, spells and elemental effects to exploit enemy weaknesses and adapt to different threats.

Form bonds with powerful companions

Discover and recruit a growing roster of companions, each with their own personality, abilities and role within the kingdom.

Companions can fight alongside you, provide advantages while exploring and unlock benefits that continue to support your settlement even when they are not accompanying you.

Navigate a fractured world

Three ancient factions disagree over how Vinterra should be saved. Their rivalry has fractured the continent, and each will attempt to influence the future of your growing kingdom.

Build relationships, complete faction objectives and decide whose vision deserves your support. The choices you make will shape your alliances and help determine what kind of ruler you become.

Uncover the truth behind the cycle

Vinterra has fallen before.

Explore its ruins, recover lost knowledge and uncover the truth behind the force that repeatedly destroys and remakes the world. Rebuild what was lost, unite those willing to stand beside you and break the cycle before everything falls once again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Designed for 1920x1080 resolution at 60 FPS using High settings. SSD recommended.
